description:
Project management is the process of planning, organizing, executing, and controlling work to achieve a specific goal within a defined time, budget, and scope.

🔑 Key Elements of Project Management
Planning
    Define what needs to be done
    Set goals, timelines, and resources
Execution
    Start working on tasks
    Assign responsibilities to team members
Monitoring & Control
    Track progress
    Fix issues if something goes wrong
Closing
    Complete the project
    Review results and performance
